question: What fast food restaurant are available within 190 kilometers during travel from 3 Palms Zoo & Education Center, Townsend, DE to Old Line Museum, Delta, PA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.695391 39.329473)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.325928 39.727238)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.695391 39.329473)',4326)::geography, 190000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.695391 39.329473)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.opening_hours: Mo-Th 11:00-20:30; Fr-Sa 11:00-21:00; Su off; PH off

[3].display_name: 3 Palms Zoo & Education Center, Townsend, DE
